items.q: What ages does your childcare centre take?
items.a: Children from 6 weeks to 6 years, in three rooms: babies (6 weeks to 2 years), toddlers (2 to 3 years) and preschool (3 to 6 years).

items.q: Do you have childcare vacancies in Harris Park?
items.a: Yes. We currently have places in every room on every day. {Join our waitlist}(/enrol) or {book a tour}(/book-a-tour) to secure a spot. [Keep up to date.]

items.q: What's the minimum number of days?
items.a: Two days a week.

items.q: How do I enrol?
items.a: Book a tour, then fill in our waitlist form. We'll call you to confirm days and a start date.

topic: Fees and the Child Care Subsidy

items.q: How much does childcare cost at Rainbow Village?
items.a: $135 a day for babies, $130 for toddlers and $135 for preschool, before the Child Care Subsidy. {See all fees}(/fees).

items.q: What's included in the daily fee?
items.a: Three meals cooked on site, nappies and wipes, full cream milk, sunscreen and incursions.

items.q: Can I get the Child Care Subsidy?
items.a: Yes, Rainbow Village is approved for the Child Care Subsidy. Apply through myGov, then give us your CRNs. [Confirm the wording.]

items.q: Do you offer Start Strong fee relief?
items.a: Yes. We receive NSW Start Strong funding, which gives extra fee relief for eligible children aged 3 and over.

items.q: Is there a bond or enrolment fee?
items.a: There's a one-week bond (refunded with one month's notice) and a $50 non-refundable admin fee.

items.q: What are your opening hours?
items.a: Monday to Friday, 7am to 6pm.

items.q: When are you closed?
items.a: Weekends and all NSW public holidays.

items.q: When can I tour the centre?
items.a: Tuesday and Thursday, 10am to 2pm. {Book a tour}(/book-a-tour).

items.q: Where are you?
items.a: 42 Weston St, Harris Park, close to Parramatta, Rosehill and Granville. {Get directions}(/contact).

items.q: Do you provide meals?
items.a: Yes. Three meals a day are cooked fresh in our own kitchen, following the NSW Munch & Move guidelines. {About our meals}(/meals).

items.q: Is your childcare food halal?
items.a: Yes. Our meals are halal and we don't serve beef or pork. Vegetarian meals are available too. [Confirm the halal wording.]

items.q: Are you a nut-free centre?
items.a: We're a nut-aware centre and don't serve nuts in our meals. Tell us about any allergy and we'll plan with you.

items.q: What are your educator ratios?
items.a: 1 educator to 4 babies, 1 to 5 toddlers and 1 to 10 preschoolers.

items.q: Is there a qualified early childhood teacher?
items.a: Yes. Our preschool program is led by a degree-qualified early childhood teacher with almost 20 years' experience.

items.q: Do your educators speak Urdu, Hindi or Punjabi?
items.a: Yes. Between them, our educators speak English, Urdu, Punjabi, Hindi, Nepali and Telugu. {Meet our team}(/our-team).

items.q: How will I know how my child's day went?
items.a: You'll get photos and updates through the OWNA app.

items.q: How do you help children settle into childcare?
items.a: We go at your child's pace. We plan the first days with you, start with shorter days if that helps, and never force a child to join in before they're ready. {Read more}(/for-parents#settling).

items.q: Can I visit during the day?
items.a: Yes. We have an open-door policy, so you're welcome any time.
